_comment: Do-not-translate terms for playbook localization. Keep ONLY true brand, product, and technical identifiers verbatim. Descriptive words around a brand (e.g. 'Developer Platform', 'Box') SHOULD be translated normally - do not put whole descriptive phrases here, or the target text becomes redundant (e.g. 'platforme ... Platform').
_preferred_terms_comment: Locale-specific renderings that regional reviewers have already corrected by hand. Applied as an extra rule in the system prompt so the model stops re-introducing a rejected term in every new playbook. Bump prompt_version when editing this, or cached translations will not pick the change up.
